summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on install
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases archive into a temp directory, `chmod 493`s the extracted `bun` binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line JavaScript blob obfuscated with a shuffled string-array/rotate-shift decoder (`WV8StW`), hex-named identifiers, and a large numeric constant pool, with no corresponding readable source in the package tree. The declared purpose of the package is a React line-item-editor UI library, which has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque install-time payload; fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated script at install time evades Node-based inspection and runs attacker-controlled logic on the installer's machine before any application code is loaded.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
